sources.title: Official Republican General Primary Ballot, May 19, 2026, sample ballot for precinct 1 (Aleppo); one such PDF per precinct, numbered (1) through (1327) at the same path
Allegheny County Elections, Election Updates (links 2026 primary results on Clarity/Scytl)

notes: Allegheny's 2026 primary results, including committee contests, are published only on the Clarity/Scytl results site (results.enr.clarityelections.com/PA/Allegheny/126196), which blocked automated access (HTTP 403); no committee results PDF or candidate list was found on alleghenycounty.us. Evidence is therefore the county's 1,327 per-precinct Republican sample ballots, each listing a County Committeeman and a County Committeewoman contest (vote for one) for that precinct. A seat with no printed candidate is 'empty_no_filer' (write-ins could still have won). A seat with one or more printed candidates is 'unknown' rather than 'filled' because the result was not verified (14 seats had two or three candidates). Ballots were parsed by script from PDF text positions. Precinct names are the ballot's (e.g. 'Pittsburgh Ward 14 Dist 39', 'Baldwin Br Dist 13', 'Up St Clair Ward 5 Dist 1').
